```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_1"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">

  <!-- Collaboration with one pool (Organisation) -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Org" name="Organisation" processRef="Process_1"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Process -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_1" isExecutable="false">

    <!-- Lanes -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_1">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Runner" name="Runner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterAppData</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectStartBlock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunMeasure</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TimeCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Train</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GetStartNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineTravel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TravelDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GoFromHome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ParallelGateway_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunNightRun</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DrinkDuringRun</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ParallelGateway_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveFinalTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_App" name="App (System)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterAppData</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Gadget" name="Fitness Gadget (System)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectGadgetData</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Start Event -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start"/>

    <!-- Tasks (App) -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterAppData" name="Enter data into app"/>

    <!-- Tasks (Gadget) -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectGadgetData" name="Collect data from fitness gadget"/>

    <!-- Runner tasks and flow -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectStartBlock" name="Select starting block"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunMeasure" name="Run 5km and measure time"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TimeCheck" name="Time < 25 minutes?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Train" name="Train and re‑measure"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GetStartNumber" name="Get starting number"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineTravel" name="Determine travel option"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TravelDecision" name="More than 1 h left?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoFromHome" name="Go to start from home"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveFromWork" name="Leave directly from work"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="ParallelGateway_Split"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunNightRun" name="Run at Night Run"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DrinkDuringRun" name="Drink during run"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="ParallelGateway_Join"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" name="Receive final running time"/>

    <!-- End Event -->
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="End"/>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_0" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_EnterAppData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Task_EnterAppData" targetRef="Task_CollectGadgetData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectGadgetData" targetRef="Task_SelectStartBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectStartBlock" targetRef="Task_RunMeasure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_RunMeasure" targetRef="Gateway_TimeCheck"/>

    <!-- Yes: good -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5_yes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck" targetRef="Task_GetStartNumber"/>

    <!-- No: need to train -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5_no" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck" targetRef="Task_Train"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Train" targetRef="Task_RunMeasure"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_GetStartNumber" targetRef="Task_DetermineTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_DetermineTravel" targetRef="Gateway_TravelDecision"/>

    <!-- Travel decision branches -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9_yes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TravelDecision" targetRef="Task_GoFromHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9_no" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_TravelDecision" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10_fromHome" sourceRef="Task_GoFromHome" targetRef="ParallelGateway_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10_fromWork" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="ParallelGateway_Split"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11a" sourceRef="ParallelGateway_Split" targetRef="Task_RunNightRun"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11b" sourceRef="ParallelGateway_Split" targetRef="Task_DrinkDuringRun"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12a" sourceRef="Task_RunNightRun" targetRef="ParallelGateway_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12b" sourceRef="Task_DrinkDuringRun" targetRef="ParallelGateway_Join"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="ParallelGateway_Join" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" targetRef="EndEvent_1"/>

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
```
